lines.text: Potiphar, captain of the guard, buys Joseph from the Ishmaelites, and the LORD makes him prosper and puts him in charge.
Potiphar's wife tells Joseph to sleep with her, but he refuses her day after day.
When no servant is inside, she grabs his cloak, and he leaves it and runs to the fields.
She tells her husband the same story, and Potiphar burns with grief.
Potiphar has Joseph thrown into the king's prison, where the LORD gives him favor with the warden and success.
